description: JASDF free-loan airframe on the factory roof; previously displayed at Nihon Land in Susono and moved here in April 2004; the only F-104J in Japan that still has the rear warning radar receiver under the tailplane trailing edge; carries 207 Sqn markings
JASDF free-loan airframe on a tower beside the main gate carrying 11 FTW markings; shootable from outside but heavily backlit with a utility pole in the way
